description: Shared foundation for the Docente panel + the first route (/docente Resumen). Creates the reusable components/docente/data.ts (mock data), charts.tsx (pure inline SVG: LineChart, BarChart, StackedBarChart, DonutChart), ui.tsx (EstadoBadge, StatCard, Stars, ProgressBar), and DocenteLayout.tsx (use client; desktop sidebar + mobile bottom nav with mascot, active links via usePathname, collapsible Aulas via useState). Then builds app/docente/page.tsx as a SERVER component (no useState) rendering DocenteLayout + a 2x2 StatCard grid + a single-series BarChart of the 6-week classroom evolution. This proves the build passes and establishes the server/client + layout pattern all later routes reuse.
steps: Create d:\EduNOva\edunova-frontend\components\docente\data.ts (NO use client). Export typed constants: class info (Matematica 1B, Seccion B, 1 Secundaria, Docente Prof. Ana Torres), class stats (promedio 15.8/20, actividades 82%, apoyo 4/20, mejora +2.4), the 20-student roster array (id,nombre,nota,progreso,estado) whose notas average exactly 15.8 with exactly 4 En inicio (see plan.md roster), Rosa Quispe's individual record (nota 12.4, actividades 8/10 80%, progreso +3.6, transversal skills 3/3/2, competencias Cantidad 12.4/Regularidad 11.8/Forma y movimiento 13.2/Gestion de datos 12.0, weekly evolution 10.8 11.2 11.6 11.9 12.1 12.4, example observation text), classroom weekly evolution [13.8,14.2,14.9,15.2,15.6,15.8], competency mastery (Cantidad 70/20/10, Regularidad 65/20/15, Forma y movimiento 65/25/10, Gestion de datos 60/30/10), topic comparison (Fracciones 15.8/16.0, Decimales 16.2/16.5, Proporciones 14.0/16.5, Porcentajes 15.6/16.0), strategy analysis (Antes 13.4/68%, Despues 15.8/82%, +2.4 pts +17.9%, causalidad disclaimer), and predictive-alert items (Pedro Salas, Rosa Quispe) with the 'No es una decision automatizada ni una evaluacion definitiva' disclaimer.

Create d:\EduNOva\edunova-frontend\components\docente\charts.tsx (NO use client; pure inline SVG). Export LineChart (viewBox 0 0 300 120; stroke #5636D9 width 2 fill none; circles r=4 fill #5636D9; auto-scale y=15+(1-(v-min)/(max-min))*80, x=20+i*52; week labels below, values above), BarChart (viewBox 0 0 320 140; accepts categories:string[] and series:{label,values,color}[]; renders single-series or grouped bars with value labels + legend; max default 20), StackedBarChart (per row an inline SVG viewBox 0 0 300 24 preserveAspectRatio none width 100% with verde #10B981 + amarillo #F59E0B + rojo #EF4444 proportional rects; competency name + percentages as HTML around it), DonutChart (viewBox 0 0 120 120; track r=45 #E5E7EB; progress r=45 #5636D9 strokeLinecap round; compute strokeDasharray = `${pct*circ} ${circ}` where circ=2*Math.PI*45; transform rotate(-90 60 60); center label as HTML overlay). NOTE: the spec's literal strokeDasharray '282 345' is incorrect for 82% — compute it from the percentage as described.

Create d:\EduNOva\edunova-frontend\components\docente\ui.tsx (NO use client). Export EstadoBadge (estado: 'Logrado'|'En proceso'|'En inicio' -> light-tint pill + colored dot, AA-contrast: Logrado bg-[#D1FAE5] text-[#065F46] dot #10B981; En proceso bg-[#FEF3C7] text-[#92400E] dot #F59E0B; En inicio bg-[#FEE2E2] text-[#991B1B] dot #EF4444), StatCard (icon, label, value, sublabel, optional accent), Stars (count out of 3, amber #F59E0B filled / #E5E7EB empty, aria-label 'X de 3'), ProgressBar (value 0-100, fill #5636D9, track #E5E7EB, aria-label).
